reviews.text: Dr. Prakash helped my cat with an enema when he was constipated for 5 days! I was so distressed, and although the doctor wasn’t exceptionally outwardly friendly, he was efficient and had compassion for my baby even when he was closing soon. The prices are great and my kitty is back to normal feeling great. We are so thankful.
They were wonderful i took new born kittens that were found in the street

I went here with my cat Bernie because I am unemployed and I could not find somewhere less expensive and was pleasantly surprised at the care he received for a $35 exam. I was quoted a much reasonable price of 350 for one tooth extraction and a dental cleaning, I made sure the doctor said he will be anesthetized because the price seems so low and most vets cost an arm and a leg for tooth extraction they did say they don’t provide x-rays for dental cleaning and no one mentioned bloodwork. I will follow up later before I take my Bernie back, but they were very, very, very helpful and polite.
The vet and their staff are amazing! They take care of my two dogs and cat. Chihuahua approved and that says a lot. 😍😍😍😍

I have come here multiple times for my different pets. Every time I have come with an appointment scheduled, but the doctor will always be very late (more than 30 minutes late), the staff is very rude, and they will talk rudely about you in Spanish thinking they are not being understood. It’s worth going else where to receive better service.

Dr. PRAKASH and the Woodlake Pet Hospital team are the best in Houston! With Houston being the fourth largest city in the US, I will not take my pets anywhere but here. I am very selective about where I take my animals. Woodlake Pet Hospital exceeds my expectations. If you're thinking about where to take your pet I suggest you get this place a try. Dr Prakash has a heart for animals and is extremely knowledgeable in regards to their care. His staff is also very knowledgeable and thorough.

Dr. Prakash Bommala is hands-down the most compassionate and skilled veterinarian we have ever visited. From the moment we walked in, his understanding nature was on full display—he was completely unbothered by Sgt. Ceaser's level of aggression, handling the situation with absolute confidence and calm. He made sure we received top-tier preventive care and all necessary vaccinations seamlessly. What truly sets him apart is the time he takes with his clients; he walked me through every detail to ensure I fully understood the next best steps for my pup's long-term health. If you are looking for an exceptional vet who delivers stellar care under any circumstances, this is the provider to choose!

I am writing this review to warn any pet owner considering this clinic for dental work. They recently performed a dental procedure on my 4-year-old dog. Initially, they told my bf they needed to extract 8 teeth. He called and let them know to only pull the ones that need to absolutely need to be pulled. and they ultimately pulled NINE of them!!! That is so predatory.

What makes this situation so concerning is that they charge a separate fee for each individual tooth extracted. This pricing structure creates a financial incentive that may not align with what is best for a young animal's health. To extract that many teeth from a dog who is only four years old is significant, and I feel the medical necessity was not clearly justified.

A 4-year-old dog should not lose such a large number of teeth without a thorough explanation or a discussion of alternative treatments. I feel blindsided and no longer have trust in their medical judgment.I will not be returning to this clinic for any future procedures. Please consider seeking a second opinion elsewhere before committing to major dental work here. It is important to find a provider that prioritizes the long-term well-being of the pet.

Also, they hug up on me when I inquired and didn’t ever speak with me before running my credit card. They should really check the name on the card before running it to make sure they match.

Will not be coming back.

Prices have gone up, it's outrageous! Everything is expensive and has gone up, but the prices here are way too high! It's on another level. And if you bring in a stray cat, just for the initial charge it's $150, plus medication, the consultation, etc. The owner of that place should be more reasonable with their prices.
The Vet is pro-active and takes good care of my Yorkie.  I'm very happy with them.

I recommend Woodlake Animal Clinic. The veterinarian Dr. P is incredibly kind and takes the time to explain everything. The clinic is clean and their prices are very reasonable. I’m so grateful to have found this clinic and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy veterinarian for day to day clinic animal care.

I bought my dog in last Thursday. Told Javier what I was there for and got a $298 estimate. Had the in-house meds removed and it went to approximately $73. When doctor enters he does not acknowledge me at all. Had to ask him his name and I think he said Bashir. Then he came back to yell at Javier for taking too long to teach me how to wash out my dog's ears because no one was at the front desk. Eyelashes had disappeared but this poor guy was all over the place. It all went south because I wanted written Rxs, not purchase meds with vet due to markups. He could have gotten me for more if he'd only had a bedside manner. Instead I had to run back and forth to Walgreens to keep asking for a written Rxs. I fell during the two trips back and reopened a wound on my knee. Terrible experience all around. And I will make sure everyone at my senior building knows about his attitude.

For over a decade, I trusted this vet with every dog I’ve loved. I followed him from a tiny clinic in the Med Center to this practice because I believed he genuinely cared. That trust died the same day my 3-pound chihuahua did.

On 05/26/26, we rushed her in to the clinic the moment she showed signs something was wrong. After bloodwork, fluids, and a stage 3 kidney failure diagnosis, we were told medication and diet changes could keep her comfortable. When she rapidly declined that same evening, I called in a panic begging to bring her back for fluids. I was told the vet would wait for me.

I drove there carrying my dying dog through traffic caused by storm outages, and end of school year traffic, only to arrive and be told the vet had suddenly left for an “emergency.” This was still 15 minutes before the office was due to close for the day. The staff was packing up to go home while I stood there holding a barely conscious dog they had seen her entire 12-year life. Then came the final slap in the face: “fluids wouldn’t help anyway” and I should go to an emergency clinic instead.

Why tell me to come at all?

My dog died in my arms hours later, cold and fading while we desperately tried to comfort her. What hurts almost as much as losing her is realizing the person I trusted for over a decade could walk away so easily when we needed him most.

If you need affordable vaccines and routine checkups, this office may be fine. But when it truly matters, when your pet is suffering and YOU are terrified—do not expect compassion, urgency, or loyalty in return. Sacrifice the extra money and find a vet who would try to comfort your dog in her last hours.
Not a fancy or luxurious place but don't get wrong, they work diligently. Dr. Bommala is a great professional and a really nice guy. Very happy.
Been coming here for years and honestly never had any issues with there services. Highly recommend them.

Today I took a kitten from my community to be spayed and paid $421. From the beginning, the receptionist wasn't very friendly. When they gave me the cat, they couldn't even put an Elizabethan collar on her, and to top it off, they gave her to me in a poorly secured carrier, and she escaped right after surgery. May God protect her wherever she is 🙏😔 because I couldn't find her anywhere. I'm really disappointed with the poor service from the staff at this hospital. The doctor is very good, but he doesn't have a good team.
Highly recommend this animal hospital.  Staff is great! Service is exceptional!
Service is very good.

It was actually my first time going to this vet because I wanted to get my dog ​​vaccinated since I had recently gotten him, and I also wanted to check if he had parasites or anything like that. He was already vaccinated, but I didn't trust the previous vet. When I arrived, I chose a package that included a consultation, several vaccinations, and deworming.  When I went in, the doctor only told me that my dog ​​had dirty ears. He drew blood, supposedly to check for parasites, but he didn't tell me anything else. They vaccinated him, and that was it. The doctor didn't even tell me if my puppy was okay. The consultation lasted no more than 5 minutes…I added that I also told them I went there because my dog ​​had an unpleasant odor in his fur that wouldn't go away even after bathing him. They never gave me an answer about this, they never said anything. The doctor simply said his ears were dirty, they vaccinated him, and that was it. They didn't explain absolutely anything to me.

Terrible service. We waited almost 5 hours, urgently, to be seen. We had a scheduled appointment and waited for hours. They attended to everyone except us, taking us into a room and charging us for the appointment, even though it was already scheduled. I don't recommend it.
They break costs down for you and do them a la cart which can be cost saving for many. They were lovely and efficient. Miss Kitty is doing great!
Reasonably priced vet in West Houston

Dr is good but his help is untrained, uncaring and irresponsible. I almost lost my baby because they didn't return 3 call backs after my visit. The excuses were I wasn't working that day and the doctor didn't have my number.

I dropped my kitten off to be spayed under the impression that it was going to be $115. When I got there, the man at the desk said it was $130 for the surgery and an additional $30 for the anesthesia wellness check. The paper with their pricing was right in front of me and it said $115 for the surgery. I ended up having to pay $170 total. I understand the pricing changed, however it’s still being advertised for $115. And I came in ready to pay $115, not $170

Been taking my pets and my mom’s pets here for awhile now whether it be an exam, neuter or recently Oreo her overweight tuxedo cat had a life threatening blockage and could not urinate. He is alive now thanks to the team!

When it comes to customer service and kindness to my furbaby,I give them a 4..But lack a star in their flexible payment options;I was having issues getting my payment to go through because money was tight..The Vet actually acted like it was checking other things when actually he was trying to check how I was trying to pay..How rude and invasive. Not cool.
Very friendly and affordable prices
Had my kitten neutered.The staff was friendly & helpful.The price was very reasonable & he was well cared for while there.Id recommend this vet.to anyone that has a pet that needs medical attention.

My dog has had episodes of diarrhea and minor injuries, and this clinic has always been kind enough to accept us on short notice, even on the same day.
Because I tend to visit on the day of the issue, the wait time can be a bit long, but the doctor is always kind and thorough, and the staff are friendly and professional.
I really appreciate their support during urgent situations.

I have brought 3 of my dogs here over the years and most recently brought my 17 1/2 year old chihuahua mix to be euthanized and get cremated. I picked up her ashes this morning to find they spelled her name wrong. Several times the receptionist seems bothered and unempathetic and when I was called to pick up her remains she said her name wrong twice. It should not be difficult to make sure a family members name is spelled correctly during such a sensitive time. After speaking to Marisol about the issue
she admitted her mistake and said she would call by the end of the day with a resolution but has since ignored my calls. Don’t waste your time or money at this vet, they do not care about your pets at all and will not make sure they’re doing everything right.
The best vet

First time calling I was automatically put on hold for over 20 minutes! They never even answered the phone to take the call on hold! This place needs a lesson in professionalism and  customer service! Guess they won't be getting me or my pets as a customer...

No one should ever have to go through what I went through, especially not during one of the most emotionally difficult moments a pet owner can face. Recently, I had to make the heartbreaking decision to have my dog euthanized. I’ve been to many veterinary clinics over the years, but this was by far the worst experience I’ve ever had. What should have been a peaceful and respectful farewell turned into something cold, rushed, and deeply upsetting.
I called ahead to make an appointment and explained the situation clearly. When I arrived, the receptionist seemed confused and couldn’t find my appointment at first—even though I was the only person in the lobby. Once she did locate it, she asked me to repeat why I was there. In that moment, I remember thinking: shouldn’t this already be noted? Shouldn’t the staff be prepared for a delicate and emotional appointment like this?
While I stood there emotionally fragile and holding my dog, three other staff members behind the desk were loudly chatting and ordering pizza. The atmosphere was completely unprofessional and lacking in empathy. The receptionist then asked me to weigh my dog on the scale in the lobby, without offering any further instructions or guidance. I stood there awkwardly, waiting for her to confirm she had what she needed, and eventually had to ask her myself. She casually said, “Yes, you’re good.” I then asked how long the wait would be, and she told me it wouldn’t be long—but it ended up being around 30 minutes.
During that wait, my dog had an accident in his bag, and I had to clean him up in the lobby. We were finally brought to an exam room, only to be left there alone for another 20 minutes. When the veterinarian and a nurse finally entered, the whole process felt rushed and mechanical. The vet said a brief “I’m sorry,” and then the nurse—who at least seemed somewhat compassionate—took over the interaction.
No one explained the process to me. They simply laid my dog on the table and prepared the injection. I asked to wipe drool from his face, which they allowed, and then just like that, they gave him the shot. They said, “Okay, she’s gone,” and I was instantly filled with regret. My dog, whom I loved and cared for over 15 years, was gone in 15 seconds. It felt so inhumane, so cold, so wrong. To make matters worse, they kept referring to my dog as “she,” even though he was a boy. I finally corrected them, but the fact that they didn’t even have that basic detail right made me feel like we were just a number to them—not a patient, not a beloved pet, just another task to complete.
I later learned from friends that in many clinics, the process typically involves a sedative first—giving the pet time to fall asleep peacefully before administering the final injection. That didn’t happen here, and I’ll never forget the panic I felt realizing how quickly and clinically it all happened.
The vet left immediately after the procedure, leaving me with the nurse. Through tears, I asked about the cremation process and whether there was any assurance that I’d get my dog’s ashes back. She gave vague, unconvincing answers. There was no paperwork in the room, no ID tags on my dog, and nothing outside the door—no chart or any identifier. Considering they couldn’t even get his gender right, how could I trust they’d return the right ashes?
I completely lost faith in the clinic. I decided in that moment to take my dog home and give him a proper burial. I immediately felt relief and peace, with that decision. I went to the front desk, requested a refund for the cremation, and left.
I originally chose this clinic because they were the cheapest, and I now deeply regret it. This experience was the definition of “you get what you pay for”
For a business whose purpose is to care for animals and support their humans, they failed miserably. The lack of compassion, professionalism, and basic respect was staggering. I wouldn’t recommend this clinic to anyone, under any circumstances.
They desperately need training in empathy, communication, and end-of-life care.

I deeply regret referring my best friend to Woodlake Pet Hospital.

They trusted my recommendation based on proximity and affordability during one of the hardest decisions any pet owner can face; saying goodbye to their dog of 15 years. What should have been a compassionate and dignified farewell became an experience marked by indifference, poor communication, and unnecessary distress.

I recently lost a dog of my own and know firsthand that this moment, though painful, can be peaceful and respectful when handled with care. This wasn’t that at all. End-of-life care is a singular moment you don’t get back. The fact that it was handled so poorly is not only upsetting, it’s infuriating.

Despite calling ahead, the clinic was disorganized and unprepared. Front desk staff were distracted, joking loudly and ordering food while my friend stood in the lobby holding their pet. No one acknowledged the sensitivity of the situation. They waited over 45 minutes before being seen, without any support or clear communication.

When the vet entered, the procedure was rushed and clinical. No sedative was offered. No one walked my friend through what to expect. The staff misgendered the dog repeatedly and failed to provide any documentation or clear process for cremation. Feeling completely unsupported and uneasy, my friend chose to take their pet home and buried him.

This was not just a missed opportunity for compassion. It was a failure of basic decency. I referred this clinic in good faith, and that choice now sits heavy on me. Pet owners deserve better. My friend and his little one deserved better.

Woodlake Pet Hospital needs serious reflection and retraining before anyone else has to endure something like this.

Saved my dogs life. And became my vet for everything, they nurtured my cat and did amazing healing was a breeze. The prices are verry affordable and they actually k ow what they are doing! I highly recommend this vet.

I call at 4pm yesterday and they said they do not take walk ins anymore so they will have to schedule me the next day. I told them my
Dog’s condition and she placed me on hold and come back to me and ask me of I can come within 30 mins. The staff are nice and accommodating! Highly recommended! Checkup is 30 dollars If I remember it right, pretty cheap than other clinics who will try to milk you for money and instead of pushing to administer all that they recommend, they will ask you if u want to do this or that and they will give you options. Thank yoi again! My dog is better today!
I have to pick one star but they don’t deserve even one. There’s no accountability with any employee or veterinary professional in this place. Cannot recommend unless you hate your animal

My experience was beyond all expectations and my expectations were based on previous experiences. Dr Prakash is highly knowledgeable and one of the most empathetic doctors I have met so far. He explained and showed us what is what and prescribed very minimal meds, instead of a hit or miss dozen medicines. Price is reasonable and cheaper than most places. They take walkins although appointments are preferred.  Clean place. Friendly staff. I am coming back here every time from now.
A great place .... reasonable prices and the doctor is wonderful

Unresposive. Understaffed. Unorganized.
Very Inconvenient. Bella only needs a nail trim.
Its been going on 4 weeks and she still can't get a trim.
Walkins means waist 4 trips with no service.
They also told me she was pregnant last year and she was NOT.
Now she has a false pregnancy on her medical records.
They also gave my DOG some CAT medication.
We will never come back.
Keep your pet away.
The Doctor I’ve always liked. The receptionist has a nasty attitude! Not kind to humans and cold to pets! Horrible!
Best visit ever. Will take my other dogs there.

I don’t usually post reviews, but I feel like I have to because of how insane my visit was.

I brought my dog here for the first time just for vaccines. My appointment time was 1p.m. Not only did several people who were walk-ins get seen before me, but I wasn’t even put into a room until 1:40, and had to wait another 20 minutes to actually get my dog seen by the doctor.

The doctor had difficulty getting a heartworm test (which requires a blood sample), and my dog’s vein was beginning to blow, so I asked if there was some kind of bandage we could put on there. They didn’t have anything. A vet clinic not having at least gauze or vet wrap is crazy.

Additionally, the complete disregard for a potential emergent situation just sitting in the lobby without being at least triaged was awful as well. I’m in vetmed, so I can identify certain trigger symptoms that would warrant needing to be checked out immediately; I overheard another customer describing the symptoms of her pet (pale gums, bloating, not eating/drinking, etc), and there was absolutely no sense of urgency. In fact, they were still sitting in the lobby when I left (and hour and some change after I got there).

I’m giving 1 star because the prices are cheap, but honestly? If there was an option to give half a star, I would.

Best, affordable and unlike inhumane doctors. This doctor truly cares, gives you the correct medicine TO CURE what is really wrong with your pets and at a reasonable price! Go figure?! The three non existing components from the human care system. Highly recommended for your family pets.
Always a pleasure bringing my fur babies to their vet appt,

The receptionist needs a little more kindness.....some of us have very difficult days and I would really like to understand when a person sleeps well and has an easy job...when others have difficult days dealing with family all because they are taking care of animals. And seeing that it is not easy to deal with expenses and the pranks of dogs, so look around and ask yourself how you can help people.

Thank you for your help with my family. I've been going with mine and have referred others to you including most recently a family member who has an appointment coming up on Saturday.
Quick service, affordable prices, and when I have had concerns they get addressed.

It's difficult to reach someone whenever I call to try and schedule appointments. Some of the staff have very negative attitudes. They act like they're so busy on the computers when you come and try to get serviced, but you can hear them gossiping and lollygagging when you're sitting and waiting or just coming in to try and be seen.  The prices are lower than most other veterinary establishmentsbut they're still pricy, I don't remember seeing any packages you could purchase during my visits. They like to price/charge everything individually. Wait times are usually long even if you've scheduled an appointment.

They accidentally gave my cat another rabies shot after I had already told them  he didn’t  need it and it was kinda scary when they come in with the supervisor and say sorry we gave your cat the wrong shot and Before that I got my female stray spayed and when I was carrying her out to the car she almost fell out because they  didn’t zip up the side of the multifunctional carrier. Yes I should’ve checked, but I’m glad I caught it when I did.. they handed me the cat after I’m waiting in the lobby and say bye so I just walked on out well I’ll never make that mistake again. I’ll always check the carrier from now on.
I’m not trying to complain because accidents will happen but I won’t be coming back here because I love my cats too much. I do thank them for everything else though. Sincerely.

Absolutely love this pet hospital! They are efficient, caring, and affordable. The veterinarian is very kind and attentive to detail. He takes the time to listen and answer any questions you have. My GSD had 2 surgeries at this pet hospital and I’ve always had a good experience.
Loving and Caring.

I had such an amazing experience here. I had needed a vet because my cat was peeing blood. I called around to so many different "low cost" vets and was quoted astronomical costs ($150 urine analysis, $250 for an x-ray to check for stones... but the visit itself was *only* $20.)
I am so glad I was able to find this vet because my visit cost less than the quote for one of the tests above. Not only that, the visit was entirely hands on and the vet and staff seemed to care for my cat rather than making money off of me and my baby.
I have found my vet! Thank you!
I love the good price and the way they treat my dog

This is an amazing place. They have gone above and beyond helping me save my dog as he battles a bad infection. They are low cost, very affordable. These people actually care. I will always recommend them from here on out and will always bring my animals here.

The doctor was very impersonal and never talked to me about my cat. He was always looking down and around many people. Very confusing to know who the doctor was. . I asked to check the ears and did it as a “big favor”. I rather pay more but to have the Vet talk to me. The rest of the people were nice. So this 2024, I’m  going somewhere else

Hello, this image was from over a week ago. 
We tried to assist as much as we could over the phone after seeing you, even suggested you bring the patient back to the clinic to further assit. You kindly declined and decided to go with over the counter medications.
We are sorry this did not meet your expections.

We’ve been going here for about 3 years since we got our cat and have really not had an issue till this past week. Zuzu came in not urinating nor pooping and we asked if there was a problem and they told us no, didn’t offer to take any x-rays nor actually considered the possibility of him having a blockage and just barely felt his abdominal. We had to go to the emergency room for him and they told us that he actually had a urine blockage and that he if he didn’t come earlier he could’ve been in serious medical trouble. When we called too the doctor lied that we opted out on an x-ray when he never even asked! I’m just grateful our cat didn’t die but just prescribing medication instead of looking at everything will hurt more than help!!! This vet used to be our go-to but this situation ruined the place for us.

I love being able to take my pets here, knowing they'll receive the proper care they need. The doctor is very knowledgeable and is always there to answer questions.  Thank you Woodlake for everything!

Very affordable compared to the clinic I originally take my cat. Brought in my sick kitty as it was nearby and they didn’t turn me away. The staff and the vet know what they are doing and are very friendly. It was my first time coming here and loved the experience.  My cat was feeling better after a day all because of the care he received here !
Very friendly

It's a really good clinic, I highly recommend it. The service is very fast compared to other clinics where you have to wait for hours. You do need to make an appointment for better service, though. They were the best for my furry friends at home! 🤗😊 …
Excellent service, very professional. My kitten had surgery and is now fully recovered.
It was great! Brought my daughter’s cat in for his wound and they took care of him with no trouble. Very professional and reasonably priced!
Really good treatment from all of the staff for me and my two cats.
They’re always so attentive and caring. I love that I can go in with my furbabies and see everything they do.
The best vet! They take care of my dog and ensure that she’s well and healthy. I highly recommend this vet for surgeries, teeth cleaning, any everything else.

Nice! Friendly staff. I walked in w/o an appointment on a Saturday and they examined my dog quickly. Full blood test with results in under 30 minutes. Dr. Prakash Bommala's "bedside manner" is great and he explained everything to me clearly. Clean environment. Fair pricing.
Highly recommend ... great staff, great care, amazing prices!! LOVE LOVE LOVE THEM!!!
I love this vet for my dog, definitely I would recommend everyone that I know to go to this place!

Great customer service, always a friendly smile, when I walk in there, it's kind of difficult to find, at first, it is around the back and it is facing condos, but I highly advise people to check it out. They have great people that care about our pets, aka family members, our furry family members, and they will work with you, I can't say enough about damn, and this establishment, great job guys keep up the good work

Brought a stray kitten I found in as he became suddenly ill. Walk ins are welcome here which is a huge plus. Staff was kind. They use a sliding scale of sorts which is also a plus , so very affordable to take care of your fur babies.
The doctor always willing to listen whatever going wrong with your furry babies!
